title: The SS never surrendered

tellings.quote: The SS is not included in the German instruments of surrender.

plain: When Germany surrendered in 1945, the SS, Hitler's elite Nazi force, never formally surrendered with it, says the researcher Jason Jorjani, pointing to the signed surrender papers: "The SS is not included in the German instruments of surrender." Jorjani offers this point while describing what he calls Hitler's secret UFO programme, and if he is right, the SS as a body would never have officially stood down.
